assignment_overview.task_summary: Create an informative and visually engaging poster that explores the concept of one of the values (Sportsmanship, Participation, On-time and On-Task, Respect, Teamwork, or Standing Strong/Resilience) in the context of sports and physical activities. The poster will be displayed in the school's gymnasium.

submission_requirements.detail: Visually appealing and informative poster about one of the listed values, submitted on ManageBac by Sunday, September 22, 2024.
